query: SELECT conname, pg_get_constraintdef(oid) AS definition, convalidated FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid='public.refusal_events'::regclass ORDER BY conname;

staging.definition: CHECK (((((refusal_source = 'policy_gate_held'::text) AND (all_refusal_codes IS NOT NULL) AND (cardinality(all_refusal_codes) > 0) AND (array_position(all_refusal_codes, NULL::text) IS NULL) AND (refusal_code = ANY (all_refusal_codes))) OR ((refusal_source <> 'policy_gate_held'::text) AND (all_refusal_codes IS NULL))) IS TRUE))

CHECK ((
CASE refusal_source
    WHEN 'held_draft'::text THEN (subject_type = 'response'::text)
    WHEN 'policy_gate_held'::text THEN (subject_type = 'response'::text)
    WHEN 'auto_post_revoked'::text THEN (subject_type = 'response'::text)
    WHEN 'ask_withheld'::text THEN (subject_type = 'solicitation_ask'::text)
    WHEN 'outreach_withheld'::text THEN (subject_type = 'solicitation_outreach'::text)
    WHEN 'batch_halted'::text THEN (subject_type = 'solicitation_batch'::text)
    WHEN 'autonomy_suspended'::text THEN (subject_type IS NULL)
    ELSE NULL::boolean
END IS TRUE))
